title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 14, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.2 (Peaked September 13, 2026 at 18:01 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 342 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)

Today’s solar images show two small sunspots, broad coronal-hole regions, and localized bright activity, while the surrounding corona looks routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
